privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: What information LT Timekeeper handles, and which device features it uses.
privacy.collect.title: Information we collect
privacy.collect.body: This app does not collect any personal information or usage data. There are no accounts, analytics, ads, or tracking cookies.
privacy.store.title: Information stored on your device
privacy.store.body: Your preferences (language, theme, volume, vibration, and end confirmation) are saved only in this browser on this device. Talk time, bells, and the display title are not saved. Clearing this site's data in your browser deletes them.
privacy.store.cache: To work offline, the app's own files and fonts are also stored in your browser.
privacy.send.title: Data sent off your device
privacy.send.body: Nothing you enter or save is ever sent anywhere. The app only goes online to load itself and its updates from lt.rinontech.com (served by Cloudflare Pages), and to load its fonts (Noto Sans and JetBrains Mono) from Google Fonts. When the fonts load, your browser's connection information, such as your IP address, reaches Google.
privacy.perm.title: Device features
privacy.perm.lead: None of these ask for permission.
privacy.perm.wake_lock: Keeping the screen awake (only while timing)
privacy.perm.vibration: Vibration (only on supported devices, when turned on)
privacy.perm.fullscreen: Full screen (only when you press the button or F)
privacy.perm.unused_list: Camera, microphone, location, notifications, contacts, photos, files
privacy.change.title: Changes to this policy
privacy.change.body: If this policy changes, you'll be told along with the app update. This policy applies as of version {version}.
